Party Puppets

By: Harri Vithi | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Yet another mayor for plek van goud

Unique Selling Point:
Kabelo Gwamanda is Joburg's new executive mayor - a man with no digital footprint and no discernible experience.

Summary:
On the 5th of May, the majority parties - ANC and the EFF presented their gold standard for executive mayor - Kabelo Gwamanda.
First impressions last and Gwamanda's appearance does not lend itself to a man one can trust to oversee the City's over R 70 billion budget and, based on his Legal City checks as well as supposed CV - it's unclear which budgets, if any, Gwamanda has managed.
Al Jama-ah party leader, Ganief Hendrick's told the Daily Maverick, Gwamnda served as an advisor to previous executive mayor's - pray tell, what was he advising on? The executive mayor does not appear to have a basic Matric certificate and his political experience is scant at the very least.
Furthermore, Gwamanda served as an advisor to the three Joburg mayor's who some say "suspiciously" died in succession in 2021 - two from Covid complications and one as a result of injuries sustained in a car accident. Therefore, Geoff Makhubo (2020/21), Mpho Moerane (2021) and Jolidee Matongo (2021) - are unable to provide glowing references on Gwamanda's purported mayoral advisory skills.

What do we know about Kabelo Gwamanda for a fact:
- He is a member of the Al Jam-ah political party which has three seats in parliament - the core of Al Jam-ah's political interest as a Muslim party, appears to be narrow - focusing on Muslim interests
- Since his election on May 5th, the so-called executive mayor has not been in a position to speak for himself - party leader Hendricks does his talking for him under the guise of Gwamanda settling into his new role before addressing the media
- In 2012, Gwamanda registered iThemba Lama Afrika a company through which he is now accused of scamming numerous Protea Glen residents. The DA has made this accusation through Dr Mpho Phalatse - now referred to as a sore loser busying herself with political mudslinging
- iThemba Lama Afrika has no digital footprint, which is odd for a business operating in the digital age but perhaps it has an old school word-of-mouth kind of approach
- Dr Phalatse has connected CB with some of Gwamanda's accusers - although eNCA is speaking with them this morning at 11 a.m so in terms of new information - it will have been repeated several times over by this Sunday, nonetheless perhaps we can glean different and new information not fleshed out in the eNCA coverage
- The DA published Gwamanda's CV on Twitter - most of the companies listed as employers are in fact companies registered by Gwamanda - begging the question, what are the executive mayor's overall achievements
- Based on the CV - which tallies in information in terms of Gwamanda's registered companies - iThemba Lama Afrika, Newtown Lifestyle Radio, PMPO General Trading and Projects CC , Innovation Hill Multimedia and the ID number listed - Gwamanda may only have a Grade 10 qualification through "Bantori Collage" in Hillbrow which, doesn't even exist anymore.
- Apparently, Gwamanda also studied business through "Parktown Collage" - perhaps Parktown Boys College? but the qualification is Business Studies not Matric
- The one company not registered by Gwamanda listed on his enviable CV is "Insiytive Holdings" - which is not traceable on the internet

Press Release:


Party Puppets
Johannesburg is the economic hub of Gauteng. It’s a cosmopolitan metropolis which boasts the tallest building in the country, a symbol of wealth, which towers high above Africa’s richest square mile. It should be the envy of every municipality, but poor service delivery, corruption and gross mismanagement, has turned the City of Gold into dust and decay. But its troubles don’t end there. While Joburg falls into a state of disrepair, the elected political elite - entrusted with the care of the city, have been squabbling for power, leaving the municipality rudderless. Now there’s seemingly a new, new sheriff in town - the third mayor in just the last five months. A man with virtually no digital footprint or discernible experience in running a multi-billion rand municipal budget, Kabelo Gwamanda, seems wholly out of his depth.
Producer: Harri Vithi | Presenter: Masa Kekana

Script:


Party Puppets
Viz: Drone shot of Johannesburg city
VO 1:
Johannesburg. City of Gold.

Viz: Drone shot of Johannesburg city – closer into the city. Buildings in Sandton City
VO 2:
It is the wealthiest city in Africa and with a R70 billion budget, it deserves leaders of the highest quality and experience.

Viz: Open manholes, potholes, gushing water taps, uncollected garbage heaps, darkness when loadshedding strikes at night
VO 3:
Instead, Joburg is crumbling as the city council prioritises political point-scoring over service delivery.

Viz: Dr Mpho Phalatse’s first ousting in parliament, strap date
VO 4:
… In September last year – the DA’s Dr Mpho Phalatse was booted out as the city’s mayor --- only to be reinstated by a court order.

VO 5:
But that victory was short lived. In January this year, Phalatse was once again, stripped of her position.

VO 6:
This time, the ANC and EFF coalition opting to make this man, from the little- known Al Jama-Ah political party - the city’s first citizen.

VO 7:
But Thapelo Amad didn’t last long either. Amad resigned amid a storm after claiming he was considering an unsolicited loan offer for the city.

VO 8:
Then the ANC EFF Coalition cherry picked another candidate from the very same Al Jama-ah party

UPSOUND: – Kabelo Gwamanda.


UPSOUND MICHAEL BEAUMONT
@ Michael Beaumont, Action SA National Chairperson:
Ultimately a candidate .... difficult to distinguish a clear constituency for that party.

VO 9:
Action SA National Chairperson – Michael Beaumont says that the new mayor lacks a clear vision.

UPSOUND: That was the problem with Thapelo, the previous candidate from AL Jama-Ah and it seems to be the problem with Kabelo as well.

VO 10:
And so far, it’s off to a rocky start for the new mayor.

VIZ: Dr Mpho Phalatse in the streets of Soweto
UPSOUND: 00:00:38:05 Dr Mpho Phalatse, Former Johannesburg Mayor
I have been talking to some ladies in the area who allege that they were scammed a few years ago.

VO 11:
In 2012, Kabelo Gwamanda and a business partner registered a company - which provided funeral services and investment solutions. But, these residents, rounded up by former mayor Dr Phalatse, allege the business was simply a scam.


UPSOUND: VICTIM
@00:02:52:06 Anonymous Victim (Sotho)
You were expected to pay about R350, R500, R1000 or even R2000 .... @00:07:05:06 Anonymous Victim (Sotho)
Nothing worked out. No one received any payout.


VO 12:
We requested an interview with Kabelo Gwamanda but we were advised he’s preoccupied with settling into the mayoral seat.

VO 13:
But Al Jama-ah, is standing by their man. Ganief Hendricks is the party leader.

UPSOUND: 40:20:12 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
The allegations are false, it's malicious it's got no merits
@06:22:05 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
...we did our vetting, we even spoke to his mother whether he would be a good candidate for mayor 

UPSOUND: @06:33:19 Masa Kekana
…his mother!? Sir with all due respect – what kind of a vetting process is this, these are serious allegations and you're telling me you even spoke to his mother? 

UPSOUND @7:48:13 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
As a political party we don't have all the resources you know like national intelligence ..

UPSOUND @8:21:00 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
On the day of elections...I sat next to his mother in the gallery and I asked her tell me about your son’s childhood… just to get a peace of mind that we are dealing with someone who has been respected by his parents, his neighbours, his peers, his colleagues… 

UPSOUND @8:48:00 Masa Kekana
Is that the kind of investigation that you did speaking to his mother his brother his peers ?

UPSOUND: @09:20:00 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
I asked the ANC to vet him 

UPSOUND Masa: you asked the ANC to vet him? 

UPSOUND @08:28:07 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
They did the thorough vetting. The SG confirmed clean bill of health.

VO 14: But we had some serious questions about the new mayor’s credentials...

@17:48:18 Masa Kekana
What are his qualifications- the straightforward answer - does he have a Matric?

@17:57:18 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
Yes, he has Matric and he has a national diploma in business you can't do a national diploma if you haven't but I haven't seen his certificate

@18:06:18 Masa Kekana
So I have a copy of his CV and it says his highest educational background he went to Bantori college ...I can also forward you this and his highest passed grade was grade 10 so does mayor Kabelo Gwamanda have a Matric sir

@18:28:03 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
… he has a national diploma in business. He was appointed by three successive mayors as a political advisor…… they won't appoint a person that is incompetent…that doesn’t have suitable qualifications

@19:05:15 Masa Kekana
Well they clearly did sir because taking a look at his CV its very thin and the majority of the companies he's listed here were actually registered by himself.

VO 15: But it seems only one of us in this interview had taken the time to read Gwamanda’s CV.

@22:10:09 Masa Kekana
Have you seen his CV?

@22:14:14 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
No I haven't seen it, I haven't seen his CV.

@23:39:20 Masa Kekana
Don't you find it bizarre Mr Hendricks that you as the party leader have not seen the COJs mayors CV and he's from your party...

@23:52:04 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
No I haven't seen the CV

VO 16: But it got even more bizarre when the Al Jam-ah party leader once again punted his “mother-knows-best” approach, to selecting mayors for the city of Johannesburg.

@24:09:22 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
A CV for me uh uh doesn't count much…I don't attach a lot of significance to a CV, I attach of confidence to the interview that I conduct with the person and I've got the expertise to identify a good man and identify the champion leader a person that can be a mayor and when I spoke to his mom she said that when he was a youngster he asked difficult questions

@25:10:15 Masa Kekana
That's what his mom told you?

@25:12:11 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
You don't respect his mom but I respect his mom


@26:44:23 Masa Kekana
We're trying to figure out if our mayor has the capability to run that kind of a City.

@26:53:05 Ganief Hendricks, Al Jam-ah Party Leader
Well the leaders of 8 political parties feel so and that counts more than your opinion.

VO 17: So while my opinion might not count, ultimately it’s Joburg’s residents who bear the brunt of political puppeteering.

UPSOUND MICHAEL BEAUMONT
@1:35 Michael Beaumont, Action SA National Spokespersom
… You've got a city that has enormous challenges as the economic hub of our country. It needs clear political leadership. *And the compromise between the ANC and EFF is actually a compromise being paid by the residents of Johannesburg, by being led by mayors that clearly are not fit for the job.*
